snippet.title: Remaking ROBLOX Obbying but in Godot [Devlog 6]
snippet.description:
After a bit a real devlog is finally uploaded, on my game Obby Revival Project. A ROBLOX like game trying to recreate the feel of r6 obbying with some extra features, due to roblox's new additions

JOIN THE OBBY REVIVAL PROJECT SERVER (Please): https://discord.gg/ug2YShgZcJ

CREDITS:
@Dankinations  - Editing and helping me out with the v0.5 release and everything
@pczm_  - Thumbnail :D
@Didm1929 For overall helping
all the github contributors :D
and you for watching

Songs used:
Wax - BSS soundtrack
Cat - C418
Droopy likes ricochet - C418
Xavier: Renegade angel main theme
